units.source_text: 是在做梦，还是幻想变成了事实。

en.t: Was he dreaming, or had fantasy become fact?

units.source_text: 他的周围突然嘈杂起来。

en.t: The space around him suddenly grew noisy.

units.source_text: 他回过神来，原来自己站在“沙崩”之中。

en.t: When he came to himself, he realized that he was standing in the middle of a sand collapse.
He slipped under the eaves and leaned against the wall.

units.source_text: 骨头像罐装鱼似的融化了。

en.t: His bones melted like fish in a can.

units.source_text: 干渴在太阳穴附近破裂了，

en.t: The thirst burst open near his temples,

units.source_text: 它的残片散落到意识的表面，成了一个个小斑点。

en.t: and its fragments scattered across the surface of consciousness, becoming tiny specks one by one.
